title: PostgreSQL JSON operators beside a named JDBC parameter
summary: The pinned named-parameter parser preserved both PostgreSQL JSON operators and bound only the application parameter.

change.description: The merge compares its first parent with the landed tree. Spring’s named-parameter parser now preserves the two-character PostgreSQL operators `?|` and `?&` without counting a bind slot.

notes: The exact NamedParameterUtils.java from each pin is compiled against the same Spring JDBC 5.0.0.M5 companions. The driver path uses pgJDBC 42.7.15 and the digest-pinned PostgreSQL 17.12 container. The recording DataSource and real database queries answer different parts of the question.
